page_title: BRE 2-0 LIL | Brest v Lille 10/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 6:14.
90+3' OFF THE POST! Remy Cabella (Lille) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot which smashes against the right post.
90+2' Chuba Akpom (Lille) was too forceful with his tackle and Thomas Leonard interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
90+1' 6 additional min. will be played.
88' The referee allows time for a substitution. Ludovic Ajorque will be replaced by Hamidou Makalou (Brest).
88' Bruno Genesio decides to make a substitution. Ismaily will be replaced by Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille).
88' What a big chance! Chuba Akpom (Lille) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
86' Brest players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
82' Substitution. Kamory Doumbia walks off the pitch and Jonas Martin (Brest) comes on as a substitute.
81' Remy Cabella (Lille) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
81' Alexsandro (Lille) leaps like a salmon to meet a lofted ball into the box, but his header from near the penalty spot fizzes narrowly wide of the right post.
79' Lille quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
75' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 8:9.
72' Eric Roy has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bradley Locko (Brest) replacing Massadio Haidara.
72' A substitution has been made. Romain Del Castillo goes off and Abdallah Sima (Brest) comes on.
72' Lille take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
70' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) goes into the book and receives a yellow card.
70' Lille control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
67' Lille take a short corner kick.
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Osame Sahraoui (Lille) comes onto the pitch so that Mathias Fernandez-Pardo can be given a rest.
66' Bruno Genesio has decided to substitute Ngalayel Mukau and he is replaced by Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille).
66' The game has come to an end for Hakon Arnar Haraldsson. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Remy Cabella (Lille).
64' Nice piece of skill by Kamory Doumbia (Brest) as he beats a few defenders, gets to the box and finishes with an accurate shot into the left side of the goal.
61' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
61' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
58' The resulting corner from Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) is cleared by the defence.
56' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul.
54' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) takes the corner with a short pass.
53' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) is flagged for offside.
53' Lille take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
52' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
51' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Thomas Leonard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
50' What a chance that is! Jonathan David (Lille) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar.
49' Massadio Haidara (Brest) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
47' Lille keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Rough tackle by Ngalayel Mukau (Lille). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45+2' The resulting set piece from Lille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Thomas Leonard signals that the goal stands! The Brest players celebrate.
44' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Brest players aren’t happy.
42' 1 - 0 Goal! Romain Del Castillo is the provider and Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) is the executioner, dispatching the cross into the bottom left corner from close in with his head. 1:0.
41' Brest work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
40' Thomas Meunier (Lille) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.

40' What an opportunity! Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the left post.
39' Thomas Leonard interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Alexsandro (Lille).
36' Lille are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
33' Mitchel Bakker is being substituted because of an injury. Bruno Genesio sends Chuba Akpom (Lille) on the pitch.
31' The game is interrupted now, Mitchel Bakker (Lille) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
30' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest).
29' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 0:2.
26' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) is first to a rebound inside the 6-yard box, but he misdirects his shot well wide of the left post.
25' Ismaily (Lille) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
23' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) commits a rough foul. Thomas Leonard stops the game and makes a call.

22' Jonathan David (Lille) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and drills a good shot to the middle of the goal. Marco Bizot shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop the effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
20' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Romain Del Castillo (Brest).
18' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) sends a cross into the box, but Marco Bizot comes off his line to gather the ball.
17' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
12' Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Brest) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the left post.
12' The ball goes out of play. Brest are awarded a corner kick.
11' Brest are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
7' The Brest players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
6' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) makes a strong challenge and Thomas Leonard blows for a foul.
4' Lille are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
2' Brest failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
1' The first half has just begun.
Brest will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Thomas Leonard.
